g.text: home — 1. the interfaces room.js and shell.js
Who implements each interface (registers with it), who uses it, who loads an implementation (with the path apps.dat.js names) and who names it.
root — the menu and the interfaces
uses (a script tag and its code)
loaded on demand by a host (the path from apps.dat.js)
names an implementation (data: an address, not a need)
External (CDN, no lines): SheetJS (xlsx), Google Fonts, three.js r128, OrbitControls, Alpine.js. Not drawn: *.md (docs), archon/ (the drawings building.dat.js comes from). Laid out with ELK (elkjs).
home — 2. the folders, each on its own
An arrow A → B: A needs B. Each folder with the lines inside it; top right, the folders it needs (it has a line into them). The root is in the first drawing.
needs: core, library, rooms/bathroom, rooms/kitchen, root
core/ — shared code, knows no project
uses (a script tag and its code)
loaded on demand by a host (the path from apps.dat.js)

External (CDN, no lines): SheetJS (xlsx), Google Fonts, three.js r128, OrbitControls, Alpine.js. Not drawn: *.md (docs), archon/ (the drawings building.dat.js comes from). Lines between folders are not drawn here. Laid out with ELK (elkjs).
